title: Contributor Code of Conduct
text: Contributors must communicate respectfully, document evidence boundaries, avoid fabricated references, avoid presenting accurate-mass candidates confirmed structures. Harassment, discriminatory conduct, deliberate data misrepresentation accepted. Report conduct concerns repository issue tracker without posting sensitive personal information.

title: DOMformulaR
text: DOMformulaR R package reproducible formula-candidate assignment visualization dissolved organic matter ultrahigh-resolution mass-spectrometry peak tables. Version 0.1.0 supports C, H, O, N, P, S. supports singly charged negative-ion [M-H]- data. contain F, Cl, Br, Na, K, Si, element logic. Accurate-mass chemical-rule matching produces molecular-formula candidates, structural identifications. Results depend calibration, resolving power, peak extraction, ion mode, blanks, replicates, parameters, manual review. package replace MS/MS, standards, blanks, replicate experiments.

title: DOMformulaR
text: workflow returns transparent S3 dom_result containing cleaned peaks, formula candidates, selected assignments, formula metrics, sample summaries, ggplot objects, parameters, logs, captured warnings.
code: library(DOMformulaR)  path <- system.file("extdata", "simulated_peaks.csv", package = "DOMformulaR") config_path <- system.file("extdata", "example_config.yml", package = "DOMformulaR")  result <- run_dom_workflow(   path,   config = config_path,   min_signal_to_noise = 6 )  result head(as.data.frame(result)) plot(result, "van_krevelen")

title: DOMformulaR
text: package imports maps vendor peak tables, validates numeric identifier fields, filters peaks, handles blank replicate occurrence rules, enumerates CHONPS candidates, retains ranks multiple candidates, calculates H/C, O/C, N/C, P/C, S/C, DBE, DBE/C, DBE/O, AI_mod, NOSC, classifies elemental operational van Krevelen groups, compares samples, exports reproducibility artifacts, returns editable ggplot2 objects. Experimental integration helpers join prepared UV-visible/EEM summary metrics, calculate formula-level carbon-oxidation energy proxy, detect paired-mass-difference candidates, join user-supplied KEGG mappings, summarize descriptive molecular turnover. preprocess raw EEM cubes, query KEGG, establish biochemical reactions, implement ecological null-model assembly inference.

title: DOMformulaR
text: Van Krevelen boundaries vary among publications configurable. AI_mod, NOSC, thermodynamic proxies formula-derived descriptors whose interpretation depends sample system. PMD edges mass-consistent transformation candidates, measured reaction fluxes. Sample comparisons descriptive unless design contains independent biological replicates.

title: DOMformulaR 0.1.0
text: Initial CHONPS-release. Added peak-table import, validation, filtering, blank replicate handling. Added negative-ion [M-H]- formula assignment complete candidate retention. Added DOM formula indices, elemental van Krevelen classifications. Added sample comparison, standardized exports, S3 workflow results, ggplot2 visualizations. Added tests, vignettes, continuous integration, pkgdown configuration, citation metadata.
